title: Your ePub Is fine
summary: A technical blog post exploring EPUB formatting compatibility issues between Kobo e-readers and Adobe Digital Editions, examining why well-formed ePub files sometimes fail validation on certain devices despite meeting standards.
problem_solved: Explains why EPUB files that pass validation still fail on Kobo devices due to inconsistent interpretation of EPUB/IDPF standards across platforms.
why_valuable: Provides practical debugging insights for eBook developers struggling with cross-platform EPUB compatibility issues that documentation doesn't address.
